heading: Circular Guarantee FAQ
subtitle: Free repairs and end-of-life garment recycling programs.

questions.question: How does the complimentary lifetime repair program work?
questions.answer: Send your garment to our repair atelier anytime for complimentary stitching repairs, button replacement, or zip slider fixes.

questions.question: What replacement hardware parts are available?
questions.answer: Spare horn buttons, zipper sliders, belt buckles, and matching thread spools are shipped free upon request.

questions.question: What is the trade-in program for worn garments?
questions.answer: Return any worn garment after 2+ years for 20% store credit toward your next purchase; returned items are refurbished or recycled.

questions.question: How long does a typical repair turnaround take?
questions.answer: Standard atelier repair turnaround is 7 to 10 business days from receipt, including return express shipping.
